> **Required package:** [`FluentMap.Analyzers`](https://www.nuget.org/packages/FluentMap.Analyzers)

## Problem solved

Catch statically provable configuration errors during compilation.

## When to use it

Use this capability when the column shape and .NET model should remain separated by explicit, reviewable configuration.

## Example

```bash
dotnet add package FluentMap.Analyzers
```

## How it works

FluentMap registers typed metadata and applies it through the matching materialization path. SQL, connections, parameters, and lifecycle remain responsibilities of the application and Dapper.

## Constraints

:::caution
Analyzers detect statically provable errors; they do not execute mapping constructors or access a database.
:::
